title: security: make security and study views private and invoker-safe
body:
## Finding

Fixes one Codex Security finding only: **Authenticated users can read cross-user security/study views**.

- Actual base SHA: `707a9a7628b122e9c15b60e0986fe74b3231eb4e` (`origin/main`, includes #1537).
- Current head SHA: `cc230d3b8541f77c26ca17a5fa24e3776d7df922`.
- Explicit exclusions: RAG log RLS, `user_profiles` credential/reset/verification column disclosure, `recommendation_feedback` compatibility, other legacy Advisor findings, and Study Hub/Auth/schema/UI refactors.

## Exact target-view inventory

| View | Private data | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `public.user_study_overview` | user name/subjects plus study, tutoring, and learning-path aggregates | postgres owner; ordinary owner-executed view; no caller predicate; authenticated SELECT | same name/8-column order; `security_invoker=true`; no PUBLIC/anon/authenticated/service_role privileges |
| `public.user_security_overview` | email, role/status, last login, failed-login/session/device/security-event counts | postgres owner; ordinary owner-executed view; authenticated SELECT | same name/12-column order; `security_invoker=true`; no PUBLIC/anon/authenticated/service_role privileges |
| `public.topic_analytics` | cross-user learner counts/progress/time/tutoring aggregates | postgres owner; ordinary owner-executed view; authenticated SELECT | same name/10-column aggregate contract; `security_invoker=true`; no PUBLIC/anon/authenticated/service_role privileges |

`topic_analytics` is included because final catalog confirmed authenticated exposure and aggregation of private learner activity. Excluding it would preserve the same root cause.

## Sensitive data classification

The retained contracts expose only their historical summary columns. The remediation adds no password hash, reset token/expiry, verification code/expiry, session token/hash, device identifier, IP/user-agent, raw security-event details, private notes, conversation history, or learning-path raw payload.

## Historical definition and grant chain

- `20260118091100_010_study_hub_extension.sql` creates `user_study_overview` and `topic_analytics` without caller predicates or invoker mode.
- `20260118091600_014_auth_system.sql` creates `user_security_overview`, grants it to authenticated, and contains a legacy all-tables authenticated grant.
- `20260219100000_fix_authenticated_grants_and_force_rls.sql` revokes legacy table ACLs, then grants SELECT on all public tables to authenticated, reopening all three.
- Ordered search found no later target replacement/ALTER/REVOKE remediation before this PR.
- New forward-only `20260712200000` sorts after every existing migration. No historical migration is edited.

## Effective owner / ACL / invoker state

Full replay before remediation: all three were `relkind='v'`, owner `postgres`, empty reloptions, authenticated effective SELECT, no PUBLIC/anon/service_role privilege, and no column ACL.

Full replay after remediation: all three remain `relkind='v'`, owner `postgres`, preserve exact column order, have `{security_invoker=true}`, and their relation ACL contains only the owner. A dynamic catalog sweep removes SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/REFERENCES column ACLs for PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, and service_role. No SELECT is restored.

## Underlying RLS / policy audit

Final replay confirmed all 10 dependencies are postgres-owned with ENABLE + FORCE RLS:

- owner-scoped: `user_profiles`, `study_records`, `ai_tutoring_sessions`, `learning_paths`, `user_login_attempts`, `user_sessions`, `user_devices`, `security_events`;
- global content inputs only: `enhanced_topics`, `study_mode_questions`.

Private SELECT policies bind to `auth.uid()` or `auth.email()`. Admin policies on login/session/device/security tables read `user_profiles.role`; #1535's final boundary removes authenticated profile UPDATE, defaults roles to student, validates allowed roles, and retains the role guard trigger. The behavior test proves a normal student cannot use those admin policies to read user B.

The other public views were reviewed individually. The unauthenticated `learning_question_search_projection` has no Data API role grant; the legacy `v_*` set contains asset/ingest quality data rather than private user/session/security/study ownership data. They are not the same finding and are intentionally excluded.

## Runtime/browser caller inventory

Exact-name search across `src`, `api`, scripts, tests, migrations, dashboards, and reporting code found:

| Surface | Database identity | Target-view caller |
| --- | --- | --- |
| browser `src/**` Supabase `.from` / RPC / REST | anon or authenticated | none |
| API routes / server services | service_role after verified auth | none |
| scripts / dashboards / reporting | service_role or postgres/direct DB | none |
| migrations | postgres/direct DB | historical definitions/grants only |
| tests/mocks | mock/test | audit fixture reference only; no runtime query |

A static regression test rejects direct `.from`, RPC, or REST use of these private views in runtime `src/**`.

## Existing API surfaces

`/api/user-profile` calls `requireAuth`, derives the verified user ID, and filters direct base-table queries by it. Its study-progress and learning-analytics modes recalculate owner-filtered `study_records`. Auth/account routes use the server service client and do not query these views. Learning session/workspace routes authenticate first and pass verified user ID to service-role repositories. No admin/dashboard route depends on a target view.

Direct authenticated view access is unnecessary; no replacement endpoint is added.

## Migration strategy

- preserve relation names and exact column contracts;
- `ALTER VIEW ... SET (security_invoker=true)`;
- revoke every table privilege from PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, and service_role;
- dynamically revoke every supported column privilege from those roles;
- restore no grant because caller audit found no legitimate caller.

## Final-catalog and temporary bad-grant tests

The PostgreSQL test runs after full ordered replay and first checks the untouched final catalog: owner, relkind, invoker reloption, relation/column ACL, exact columns, definitions/dependencies, sensitive-field exclusions, aggregate-only topic shape, underlying FORCE RLS, owner policies, and the protected admin-role dependency.

It then creates transactional users A and B with study/tutoring/path/login/session/device/security fixtures:

1. final ACL: anon, authenticated, and service_role SELECT all fail;
2. temporary bad grant: authenticated user A queries all three invoker views;
3. only A profile/study/security data and A-only private aggregates are visible;
4. explicit checks reject B email/role/status/last_login, subjects/progress/time, sessions, devices, events, and login attempts;
5. the grant is rolled back and denial is rechecked;
6. all fixtures roll back.

This distinguishes final ACL denial from invoker-mode defense in depth.

## Migration-order mutation coverage

The detector reads all ordered migrations. It allows historical unsafe definitions as audit evidence, requires a later remediation, and rejects post-remediation unsafe CREATE OR REPLACE, invoker RESET/false, PUBLIC/anon/authenticated grants, blanket grants, column SELECT grants, underlying RLS weakening, sensitive security columns, owner-executed replacements, service_role drift, and DROP + unsafe recreate.

The #1537 recommendation contract received only the required compatibility correction: it no longer assumes its own remediation is the last migration, while existing later-migration and mutation checks remain active.

## Exact local results

- New security/study static contract after review hardening: **19/19 passed**.
- Combined migration-order security contracts: **4 suites, 109/109 passed**.
- Review-focused static rerun: **2 suites, 49/49 passed**.
- Fresh pgvector/Postgres 16 full migration replay including this migration: **passed**; the pg_cron-only retention migration was skipped because pg_cron is unavailable in the CI-equivalent image.
- New final-catalog / SET ROLE SQL: **passed**, including temporary bad-grant defense in depth.
- Existing user-profile role, recommendation RLS (with overload sweep), and evidence-context RPC (with overload sweep) SQL contracts: **passed**.
- User profile/auth/auth-context/auth-guard/API Route Integration/Security Baseline/Security Depth: **9 suites, 136/136 passed**.
- Supabase audit-core and learning ownership set: initial **59/68 passed**; 8 localhost-listener EPERM cases rerun with listener permission and then **8/8 passed**. One unrelated `workspace-read-service` inline snapshot remains failed because current `origin/main` runtime output already includes `user_id`; the test and workspace implementation inputs are unchanged by this PR.
- DB Contract: **pass, 6/6 checks**.
- Migration Smoke: **pass, 3/3 checks**.
- Local Security Advisors: **52 existing results; 0 target `security_definer_view` hits**.
- `supabase db lint`: unavailable because the local image could not enable `pgsql_check`; not claimed as passed.
- ESLint on changed JS: **passed**.
- Workflow YAML parse: **passed**.
- `git diff --check`: **passed**.
- Final Codex preflight: **healthy**, clean worktree, upstream synchronized.

## GitHub Actions terminal states

Current head `cc230d3b8541f77c26ca17a5fa24e3776d7df922`:

- CI Security Guard #104 — **success**
- RAG S1 Contract Gate #1375 — **success**
- Lint Gate #1329 — **success**
- DB Contract Gate #125 — **success**
  - DB Contract + Migration Smoke — **success**
  - Mark Decision RPC Security Contract — **success**
  - Evidence Context RPC Security Contract — **success**
  - Rubric Extraction RLS Security Contract — **success**
  - User Profile Role Security Contract — **success**
  - Recommendation RLS Security Contract — **success**
  - Security and Study Views Contract — **success**
- RAG Boundary Tests #493 — **success**
  - Boundary Contract — **success**
  - Boundary DB Guardrail — **success**

## Review thread states

Thread-aware GraphQL readback after per-thread replies:

- total threads: **4**
- resolved: **4**
- unresolved: **0**
- outdated: **0**
- new automated review threads: **none**
- new top-level conversation comments: **1** automated Codex usage-limit notice; it is not a review thread or code finding
- `CHANGES_REQUESTED` reviews: **none**

Disposition:

- comment-safe `stripSqlComments` scanner — implemented in `cc230d3b8`, replied with 19/19 focused and 109/109 combined contract evidence, then resolved;
- dollar-quote handling in `splitTopLevelList` — implemented in `cc230d3b8`, replied and resolved;
- dollar-quote handling in `findTopLevelFrom` — implemented in `cc230d3b8`, replied and resolved;
- column-order comparison — replied and resolved without changing code because exact `pg_attribute.attnum` order is an intentional compatibility contract for `SELECT *`, schema consumers, migration compatibility, and replacement-drift detection.

## Remaining limitations

- Migration has not been deployed.
- Local pgvector image lacks pg_cron and pgsql_check as noted above.
- The unrelated pre-existing workspace snapshot drift is not changed in this single-finding PR.

No production, staging, linked, or remote Supabase database was connected to or modified. No remote users or security/study data were created or changed.
